propositions: The retry/error cluster must be moved out of transport.py into a new retry.py module without changing any behaviour.
transport.py exceeds available headroom under the LOCKED 800-line module-size cap, forcing the split before a new 429 policy can be added.
TlsVerificationError must move together with its factory _tls_verification_error to avoid a circular import between transport.py and retry.py.
transport.py must re-export the moved names so existing importers, including test_jira_dc_config_settings.py, pass with zero test edits.
No control flow, retry counts, backoff values, or exception types may change; the diff must be a pure move.
The 429 / Retry-After policy handling is explicitly out of scope and deferred to a separate story.
